task_criteria: BT-85 acceptance: add a real make cover-check gate using go test ./... -count=1 -short -coverprofile=<tmp>; enforce total >=80% and every non-exempt package >=60%, with named reasoned exemption for statement-less internal/secretscheck. Make the gate load-bearing: pass at current coverage and forced failure (for example min-package 95) naming the offending package. Add hermetic checker unit tests for total/package below floor, exemption, empty/malformed profile, exact boundary. CI runs the same command as make cover-check, README documents target/floors/exemptions. Preserve all existing build/vet/full-test/fmt/version/spec/vuln gates and leave no generated artifacts.

  ✗ BT-85 acceptance: add a real make cover-check gate using go test ./... -count=1 -short -coverprofile=<tmp>; enforce total >=80% and every non-exempt package >=60%, with named reasoned exemption for statement-less internal/secretscheck. Make the gate load-bearing: pass at current coverage and forced failure (for example min-package 95) naming the offending package. Add hermetic checker unit tests for total/package below floor, exemption, empty/malformed profile, exact boundary. CI runs the same command as make cover-check, README documents target/floors/exemptions. Preserve all existing build/vet/full-test/fmt/version/spec/vuln gates and leave no generated artifacts.: Most of the acceptance is satisfied: Makefile:102-105 runs `go test ./... -count=1 -short -coverprofile=$$tmp/coverage.out` then `go run ./cmd/covercheck --min-total=80 --min-package=60 --exempt=internal/secretscheck` with a trap-cleaned tmp dir; `make cover-check` passes at current coverage ("covercheck: total 83.1% of statements (floor 80.0%)", "lowest package .../internal/describe 66.5% (floor 60.0%)", "exempt internal/secretscheck: not present in profile (zero statements, exempt by policy)", "covercheck: PASS: 14 packages evaluated", exit 0); forced failure with --min-package=95 exits 1 with 13 findings naming packages ("FAIL package .../internal/describe coverage 66.5% is below floor 95.0%"); hermetic tests exist for total below floor (internal/covercheck/covercheck_test.go:147), package below floor naming the package (:171), exemption (:197), empty/malformed profile table (:71, 10 cases), exact boundary (:245), plus cmd/covercheck/main_test.go:32-99 — `go test -count=1 ./internal/covercheck ./cmd/covercheck` -> ok/ok; CI .github/workflows/ci.yml:49-50 runs `make cover-check` and preserves build/vet/gofmt/version-check/spec-check/vuln-check/test steps (lines 19-53); README:1555 and 1655-1675 document the target, 80%/60% floors, unrounded comparison, exit codes and the named reasoned secretscheck exemption; go build ./... OK, go vet ./... OK, `go test -count=1 -short ./...` all 15 packages ok, TestGofmt/TestVersioncheck/speccheck/TestVulncheck ok; no coverage/profile artifacts tracked (git ls-files clean). HOWEVER the gate is not load-bearing as required: HEAD is d1bdcc7 (not the d772169 revert the task states), and cmd/covercheck/main.go:58-63 re-adds an undocumented `MIN_PACKAGE_COVERAGE` env override that mutates the per-package floor default before flag parsing. Nothing in the Makefile, CI, README or tests references it (grep hits only main.go:58,60), and `MIN_PACKAGE_COVERAGE=95 make cover-check` fails with "make: *** [Makefile:103: cover-check] Error 1" — a hidden bypass surface contradicting README:1663-1665 ("the floors live in the Makefile only and cannot drift") and the repo's own prior revert commit d772169 which removed this exact code for that reason.
The cover-check gate, tests, CI wiring and README docs are all real and verified passing, but the working tree re-introduces an undocumented MIN_PACKAGE_COVERAGE env override in cmd/covercheck/main.go:58-63 that silently changes the per-package floor, so the gate is not load-bearing as the acceptance requires.
